title: Relative Proj
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\mathcal A=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}\mathcal A_n$ be a commutative unital graded $\mathcal O_X$-algebra sheaf [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures], quasi-coherent as an algebra sheaf [def-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-algebra]. For every affine open $V\subseteq X$, put $R_V=\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_X)$, $C_V=\Gamma(V,\mathcal A)$ with its induced grading, and $P_V=\operatorname{Proj}(C_V)$ [def-nagata-affine-proj]. Its map $p_V:P_V\to V$ is the composite of the degree-zero structural map $P_V\to\operatorname{Spec}(C_{V,0})$ and the spectrum map induced by the unit $R_V\to C_{V,0}$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. No equality $\mathcal A_0=\mathcal O_X$ is required.

The relative Proj construction consists of the following specified data. Choose an affine open cover $(V_i)_{i\in I}$ of $X$ (one may take all affine opens). Use the local models $P_{V_i}$ and their inverse-image open subschemes $p_{V_i}^{-1}(V_i\cap V_j)$. The overlap isomorphisms are the maps induced by restriction of $\mathcal A$, described on affine refinements by coefficientwise localization and on standard Proj charts by the corresponding degree-zero homogeneous localization maps. Include their identity, inverse, and triple-overlap cocycle equalities in the gluing datum. Glue these schemes over $X$ using the relative scheme-gluing construction [lem-weil-pbc-relative-glueing-affine-opens]; denote the resulting scheme and structural map by $\operatorname{Proj}_X(\mathcal A)\xrightarrow{\pi}X$.

The construction also records, for every affine open $V\subseteq X$, the restriction isomorphism $i_V:\pi^{-1}(V)\xrightarrow{\sim}P_V$ over $V$. For affine opens $W\subseteq V$, the composite $P_W\xrightarrow{i_W^{-1}}\pi^{-1}(W)\hookrightarrow\pi^{-1}(V)\xrightarrow{i_V}P_V$ is the map induced by $C_V\to C_W$ on the same localized charts. These equalities are part of the specified compatibility data. Existence of this datum, and independence of the cover up to unique isomorphism respecting the chart identifications, are the separate statement of lemma-nagata-relative-proj-exists; they are not additional defining hypotheses on $X$ or $\mathcal A$. Here the $P_V$ are Proj schemes over affine bases, not necessarily affine schemes. No intersection $V_i\cap V_j$ is assumed affine. All such overlaps are handled by affine refinements.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme and
$\mathcal A=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}\mathcal A_n$ a quasi-coherent graded
$\mathcal O_X$-algebra. On every affine open $V\subseteq X$, form

$$
\operatorname{Proj}(\Gamma(V,\mathcal A)).
$$

Quasi-coherence identifies the graded algebra on a basic affine restriction
with coefficientwise localization. The intended relative Proj is the scheme
obtained by gluing these affine Proj schemes along the induced standard-chart
equivalences, with structural map to $X$ glued from the degree-zero maps.
The construction includes the chosen affine cover, all overlap
isomorphisms, their cocycle equalities, and the resulting universal
restriction isomorphisms.
